stories.headline: Israel’s Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu’s party of stalling coalition talks
stories.description: Yashar party chief says Likud wants to drag Israel into another election under the outgoing government.

stories.headline: Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy, halts flights and ticket sales
stories.description: Passengers advised to seek refunds via bankruptcy process, though guarantees are not assured, warns Norse Atlantic.

stories.headline: Trump backs Iraqi PM’s oil smuggling crackdown
stories.description: Baghdad closes border crossings as Kurdish authorities warn of constitutional violations and call for meeting.

stories.headline: Serbia’s student-led movement nominates chemistry professor for presidency
stories.description: Radomir Saicic, who teaches at Belgrade University, was among the first university professors to join the movement.

stories.headline: Canada’s top court largely upholds Quebec’s religious symbols ban
stories.description: Quebec’s ban on teachers and police wearing religious symbols such as hijabs and turbans on the job remains in place.
